items.title: 68163_Tom Whaley oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] He was there when Bill Vodeery was there. ... [INTERVIEWEE] I think so.

ctx.x: He was there when Bill Vodeery was there. I listened to a couple of stories. I talked to Eubie Blake, and he told me a couple of stories that I wanted to see if you remember or if you can verify. That -- the name escapes me, the comedian we were talking about, what's his name?
